scope: Descriptive decomposition of 72 existing C5_M110 development paths (original DEV24+VAL48). No TEST data, Plant calls, training, counterfactual, or candidate selection.

channel_units.initial: initial e/sigma normalized state in m; T0=1 s
channel_units.sampling_position: rho_p position transition forcing in m
channel_units.sampling_surface: T0*rho_s normalized surface transition forcing in m; T0=1 s
channel_units.pre_ready: actual DT*(u-d0) in sigma transition forcing, samples 0..319
channel_units.tail: actual DT*(u-d0) in sigma transition forcing, samples 19990..19999

grouped_channel_definitions.warning: The delayed target y cancels algebraically between prediction and ramp_and_interval; individual F1/F2 energies depend on that decomposition. Interpret their grouped response and cross-terms, not either channel alone.

phase_definitions.state_sample_20000: used only for final recursion/reconstruction check, excluded from Q/Gram

gram_definition: G[i,j] = mean_time(response_i * response_j), units m^2; all symmetric cross terms retained.
group_aggregation: Equal weight per scene; pooled Gram is also reported, separately from scene-equal mean Q.

ALL72.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

HF_W09_W14.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

W15.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

T1.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

T2.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

T3.aggregation: Equal scene weight; all scenes have the same sample count in each phase.

interpretation_limit: Fixed-path linear response identity only. It does not predict retraining, a changed target, a counterfactual closed-loop trajectory, causal component benefit, or novelty.
